title: Morning Line
notes: Outline, stage 2, main quest step: "Pick your morning structure: where the alarm sits, where the phone sleeps, coffee or not. An overbuilt option is on the menu: 5 a.m. gym, cold shower, journaling, meal prep. It looks great on day one and collapses by day two. When it does, the restart sequence opens." Claude's draft.
Choosing the phone in the kitchen earns the Phone in the kitchen card (outline: earned in Morning Line).
Your choices apply from tomorrow morning.

text: Tomorrow morning starts tonight. Three small decisions, made once, so you don't have to make them at 6:30 with the phone lit a foot from your head.
First: where does the phone sleep?

choices.label: In the kitchen. An old alarm clock goes by the bed.
On the nightstand, face down.
effects: set:mPhone=Phone face down on the nightstand.

choices.label: Across the room. You have to stand up to stop it.
Coffee first, then out the door.

text: That's it. It fits in one breath.
Or. There's the other version, the one that looks great on paper: 5 a.m. gym, cold shower, journaling, meal prep. Do it right. All of it.

choices.label: Keep it that small.
result: Small enough to do on a bad morning. That's the point.

choices.label: Do it right. 5 a.m. gym, cold shower, journaling, meal prep.
result: It looks great. You can already see yourself doing it.
choices.record: Set a morning line: 5 a.m. gym, cold shower, journaling, meal prep.
effects: set:morningLabel=5 a.m. gym, cold shower, journaling, meal prep.

effects.objective: Set: the full program, starting tomorrow at 5:00 a.m.
